$comment: Illustrative Safety Perspective fixture. All organizations, records, and results are synthetic. The declarations carry evidence for review, not a safety certification or an independently established authorization.

requirements.name: Therapy command integrity
requirements.description: Only authentic therapy commands are accepted in the stated deployment.
requirements.rationale: Command integrity prevents unintended drug delivery in the classified therapy path.

claims.predicate: Requirement SR-041 is not satisfied by firmware 3.2.0 in the tested certificate replacement configuration.
claims.reasoning: The test exercises the safety-relevant command path using a substituted certificate. Acceptance of an unauthentic command directly violates SR-041, so the failed result supports the non-conformance finding.

attachment.content: TR-042; subject: asset-tls-path; firmware 3.2.0; requirement SR-041. Method: replace gateway certificate, send unauthentic therapy command, observe delivery command acceptance. Expected: reject. Observed: accepted. Result: fail.

REVIEW-042; subject: asset-tls-path; assessment: assessment-validation-failure; disposition: request change, release blocked. Reason: failed SR-041 validation demonstrates an unauthentic command can enter the therapy path. Reviewer: Example product safety manager; process: Example lifecycle policy P-01 revision 1. CR-042 tracks the proposed modification and replacement verification; they are not completed by this assessment.

risks.name: Failed command-integrity validation
risks.statement: The tested certificate replacement permits an unauthentic command and could cause unintended delivery.

impact.description: Incorrect drug delivery to a patient.

inherentRisk.rationale: Example qualitative hazard-analysis method H-01 revision 1: catastrophic denotes potential death or permanent injury from unintended delivery. No event probability or numeric risk score is asserted.

assessments.name: Safety impact assessment of TR-042
assessments.scope: Pump firmware 3.2.0, Globex TLS 1.4.2, and the hospital deployment therapy command path. No claim about other products or deployments.
assessments.summary: The impact assessment is completed, but SR-041 fails validation. Release is blocked under the example lifecycle process; correction and verification rerun remain open in the authoritative change record.

externalReferences.comment: Review record distinguishes the completed assessment from unfinished corrective work.
Authoritative change record: firmware correction proposed; replacement verification to be added; previous result retained. No release approval recorded.

assumptions: This result applies to the tested certificate replacement and firmware 3.2.0. A later correction requires a new assessment and verification evidence.

damageScenarios.name: Unintended drug delivery
damageScenarios.description: An unauthentic therapy command changes delivery to a patient.

impacts.description: Potential patient harm from unintended drug delivery; the example severity label is interpreted under the fictional manufacturer hazard-analysis process.

annotations.text: TR-042: validation of firmware 3.2.0 found that a gateway certificate replacement permits an unauthentic therapy command. This report initiates assessment; it does not prescribe or approve a change.
